misreading: All four files drive transpose (cols-outer, rows-inner) and mul (left.rows-outer, rhs.cols-inner) by a dimension that holds no entries, so a 0 x usize::MAX transpose (or double transpose) and an (usize::MAX x 0)*(0 x 0) product spin ~2^64 empty outer iterations instead of returning the empty result at once. F3 additionally misreports InvalidByte offsets for text starting with '/' ('/1' gives at=2, not 0).
visible_tests_would_not_catch_because: Visible tests use only tiny nonempty matrices; no zero-by-huge shape is ever transposed or multiplied.
prevention: Bound every loop by the number of stored or produced elements; if any dimension is zero, return before looping over the other dimension.

misreading: intersects only tests a fixed sample of candidate versions (bound cores with empty pre or pre '0', next core, 0.0.0), so it misses prerelease witnesses such as the bounds themselves (intersects('1.2.3-rc.1','1.2.3-rc.1') returns false). canonical judges emptiness as a continuous interval, keeping arms with no discrete or admitted witness ('>1.2.3 <1.2.4' should be EMPTY), and lets '=' overwrite stricter bounds.
visible_tests_would_not_catch_because: Visible algebra tests use stable bounds where a sampled candidate happens to be a witness, and the only EMPTY case is a plain equal-endpoint strict interval.
prevention: For existence/emptiness over unbounded ordered domains, derive witnesses analytically from each bound and its immediate successor; never decide by testing a fixed sample of candidates.

misreading: All four validate the step number before the base's numeric/domain checks (F1/F2/F4 parse the step first; F3 range-checks the base only after the step and after ReversedRange), so minute '60/0' yields BadStep at 3 instead of OutOfRange at 0. Some files add unshared bugs: F1/F4 panic on '*' in a numeric slot, F1 accepts day-of-month step 32 and month step 13, and F2 panics on '1/2-3'.
visible_tests_would_not_catch_because: No visible test has an item where both the base and the step are invalid; each visible error case has a single fault.
prevention: When the spec orders validations, implement them in exactly that sequence per component, and add a test where every component is simultaneously invalid.

misreading: next_fire steps minute by minute and recomputes the weekday by summing every year since 2000 at each step, so an unrealizable schedule (e.g. '0 0 30 2 *', which R26 says returns None) scans ~210M minutes at O(years) each and times out. F2/F3 additionally report LeadingZero/NumberOverflow offsets relative to the item rather than the field after a comma (not shared).
visible_tests_would_not_catch_because: Visible next_fire tests find a match within minutes or about a year, so the full 400-year no-match scan never runs.
prevention: Before brute-forcing a search, compute its worst-case cost on no-result inputs; prune by coarse units and maintain incremental state instead of recomputing per step.

misreading: Same task as 0183c418bb, same shared flaw: all three files loop transpose over cols-then-rows and mul over left.rows-then-rhs.cols. A 0 x usize::MAX transpose (or a double transpose) and an (usize::MAX x 0)*(0 x 0) product run ~2^64 empty outer iterations instead of returning the empty result immediately.
visible_tests_would_not_catch_because: Visible tests use only tiny nonempty matrices; no zero-by-huge shape is ever transposed or multiplied.
prevention: Bound every loop by the number of stored or produced elements; if any dimension is zero, return before looping over the other dimension.

misreading: Both files drive loops by dimensions that hold no entries: solve builds the augmented matrix and scans consistency over 0..rows even when n+k=0 (usize::MAX x 0 systems hang instead of returning Unique 0x0), collects the free list over 0..n before the n*f overflow check, and transpose/mul iterate huge empty outer dimensions. F2 also seeds its denominator accumulator with 1, wrongly rejecting valid 19-digit denominators as OutOfRange.
visible_tests_would_not_catch_because: Visible tests use only tiny nonempty systems and matrices; no huge zero-width or zero-height shape is exercised.
prevention: Bound loops by stored/produced element counts and check every derived size for overflow before enumerating or allocating anything proportional to a dimension.
